Product Details: Hex-Logic pads are designed and developed for today's most demanding retail professionals. Designed and tested to the strictest and highest requirements of our OEM customers, these pads use the best foams from around the world and the latest testing and research and development. Unlike traditional pads, Hex-logic pads use a precision system, laser-cut hexagons to not only distribute the right amount of product throughout the pad but also provide 100% coverage on a flat or rounded/angled surface. Just like the way bees build a honeycomb to evenly distribute honey and pollen, Hex-Logic pads keep the product in the groves as you start and when the pad is spun and rubbed against the surface, the varnish moves thinking the hexagonal grooves evenly penetrate into the pad, providing a superior precise finish, while keeping the surface consistently lubricated to reduce friction and scratches. The stamp's unique laser-cut hexagonal surface allows the Hex-Logic pads to conform to the shape of the surface, providing maximum contact with the surface while distributing product evenly throughout the pad to minimize heat.
